# Copilot Workspace Instructions

Before any coding task in this repository:

- Read AGENTS.md first.
- Read README.md for product context and runtime notes.
- Confirm the target app folder before editing:
  - backend for API and backend logic
  - fe-web for the main web app
  - fe-mob for the main mobile app
- Keep edits minimal and scoped to the selected folder.
- Do not mirror the same change across variant folders unless explicitly requested.
- Preserve API contracts unless the request explicitly requires contract changes.
- Run checks/tests relevant to the edited area when feasible.
- Avoid unrelated file changes.

When task routing is unclear, ask which app folder should be targeted before making edits.
